description: SemVer releases for Orchestra: one version source, Keep a Changelog, release.yml on push to main, retire CalVer tooling.

userStories.title: One release version for the whole repository
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one file to hold the release version. Then the API, the client, the images, and the tag report the same version.
acceptanceCriteria: `backend/pyproject.toml` `[project] version` holds the release version in `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` form.
`frontend/package.json` `version` equals the `backend/pyproject.toml` version.
`backend/scripts/check-version-parity.sh` exits 0 when the two versions match and exits 1 with a message that names both files when they differ.
The `test-backend` job in `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs `backend/scripts/check-version-parity.sh`.
If `APP_VERSION` is unset, `src.constants.APP_VERSION` equals the `backend/pyproject.toml` version.
If `VITE_APP_VERSION` is unset, the client build uses the `frontend/package.json` version.
`backend/tests/unit/test_app_version.py` passes under `make test` and covers the default and the override.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: pyproject version 4.0.0 read by parity script. 2 executed: check-version-parity.sh -> 'Version parity OK: 4.0.0' exit 0. 3 executed: PACKAGE_JSON_FILE override at 4.0.1 -> exit 1, message names both files. 4 reasoned: test.yml test-backend step 'Check version parity' at line 112; runs in CI on push. 5 executed: tests/unit/test_app_version.py 2 passed (default + override). 6 executed: frontend app-version.test.ts 2 passed; npm run build exit 0. 7 executed: make test 833 passed, 2 skipped on integrated branch.

userStories.title: Keep a Changelog format
userStories.description: As a reader of release notes, I want `Changelog.md` in Keep a Changelog form with an `[Unreleased]` section. Then each release has a section that the release workflow can publish.
acceptanceCriteria: The `Changelog.md` header states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and SemVer, and names `backend/pyproject.toml` as the version source.
`Changelog.md` holds `## [Unreleased]` above every version section.
`## [Unreleased]` uses only the categories `### Added`, `### Changed`, `### Deprecated`, `### Removed`, `### Fixed`, and `### Security`.
The `## 2026.9.27` entries move under `## [Unreleased]` as one sentence each, with a PR link, at 250 characters or less.
The CalVer sections from `## 2026.9.14` and older stay unchanged below a `## Legacy CalVer releases` heading.
The `## Planned` section moves to a GitHub issue or to `docs/`, and `Changelog.md` no longer holds it.
`CONTRIBUTING.md` states the entry rule: one imperative sentence, 250 characters or less, a PR or issue link, under `## [Unreleased]`.
userStories.notes: 1 reasoned: header names Keep a Changelog 1.1.0, SemVer, backend/pyproject.toml source, frontend mirror, v tags. 2 executed: [Unreleased] is first ## section. 3 executed: categories Changed/Removed/Fixed only. 4 executed: 4 bullets, lengths 139/200/141/124, each links a PR or issue. 5 executed: diff of region from '## 2026.9.14' vs origin/development exit 0; heading '## Legacy CalVer releases' directly above. 6 executed: grep '^## Planned' count 0; content moved to docs/roadmap.md (docs/README link deferred to US-005). 7 reasoned: CONTRIBUTING.md '### Changelog entries' states the rule.

userStories.title: Release workflow on push to main
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a push to `main` to validate the commit, reserve the `v<version>` tag, publish the images, and publish a GitHub Release. Then no person creates a tag by hand.
acceptanceCriteria: `.github/workflows/release.yml` runs on each push to `main`.
The workflow runs the backend tests, the frontend tests, the frontend build, and `backend/scripts/check-version-parity.sh` before any tag, image, or release changes.
The workflow reads the version from `backend/pyproject.toml`.
If tag `v<version>` exists on a different commit, the workflow reports the version as released, skips each publish job, and ends green.
If tag `v<version>` exists on the same commit, a rerun completes without a duplicate tag or a duplicate release.
The workflow pushes `ghcr.io/mifunedev/orchestra-api` and `ghcr.io/mifunedev/orchestra-worker` with the tags `<version>`, `sha-<full sha>`, and `latest`.
The workflow keeps `ghcr.io/mifunedev/orchestra` as an alias of the API image with the same three tags.
The GitHub Release body is the `Changelog.md` section for `<version>`, or the `## [Unreleased]` body when that section does not exist.
Image tags and the release name use the bare version. Only the git tag and the release title use the `v` prefix.
userStories.notes: 1 reasoned: on.push.branches [main]. 2 reasoned: reserve needs test-frontend+test-backend (npm test, npm run build, check-version-parity.sh, pytest). 3 reasoned: Read version step uses tomllib on backend/pyproject.toml. 4 reasoned: tag_commit resolves annotated tags; existing != GITHUB_SHA -> noop=true, exit 0; publish-image/finalize gated on noop=='false'. 5 reasoned: existing tag on same SHA skips create; gh release view guards create; finalize uses gh release edit. 6-7 reasoned: api build tagged orchestra-api and orchestra with <version>, sha-<sha>, latest; worker build separate. 8 executed: changelog-section.sh 4.0.0 prints [Unreleased] body on real file and the [4.0.0] section on a temp copy. 9 reasoned: image tags bare; git tag and release title v<version> (GitHub has one name field; matches agro). actionlint exit 0. Unverified until first push to main: docker build/push, gh API calls. Known limit: if tag creation fails for a permission reason, reserve reports noop and ends green.

userStories.title: Retire CalVer tooling
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the date-based tooling removed. Then no command creates a CalVer tag or a CalVer changelog header.
acceptanceCriteria: The root `Makefile` targets `changelog` and `tag` no longer exist.
`backend/scripts/tag.sh` no longer exists.
`.github/workflows/build.yml` no longer runs on `push: tags: ["*"]`. `release.yml` owns image publication.
`.github/workflows/deploy-docker.yml` and `.github/workflows/deploy-vm.yml` accept a SemVer tag, and the input description shows a SemVer example.
`git grep -n -E 'YYYY\.M\.D|date-based' -- ':!Changelog.md'` prints no line.
userStories.notes: Commits 7bdbb7d5 + c14cd09b. 1 executed: make -qp shows no changelog/tag targets (root and backend). 2 executed: backend/scripts/tag.sh not tracked. 3 executed: build.yml deleted (duplicated release.yml publish; its auto-deploy on tag is dropped, manual deploy-docker.yml remains). 4 executed: deploy-docker input 'e.g. 4.0.0', deploy-vm input 'e.g. v4.0.0'; rc/agent gates removed; actionlint -shellcheck= exit 0 (pre-existing shellcheck findings unchanged). 5 executed: grep for YYYY.M.D|date-based|tag.sh|make changelog|make tag outside Changelog.md and .agro/tasks exit 1; hits inside .agro/tasks are the plan quoting the pattern.

userStories.title: Release branch and release procedure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a `main` branch and one documented procedure to promote `development` to `main`. Then each release comes from a validated commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Branch `main` exists on `origin` and starts at the `development` commit that bumps the first SemVer version.

`docs/releasing.md` states the procedure: bump the version in both files, move `[Unreleased]` to `## [<version>] - <YYYY-MM-DD>`, merge to `development`, fast-forward `main`, and monitor `release.yml`.
`docs/README.md` links `docs/releasing.md`.
The first push to `main` publishes release `v4.0.0` with the images and the GitHub Release.
`gh release view v4.0.0 --repo mifunedev/orchestra` exits 0.
`git ls-remote --heads origin master` prints no line.
`docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/mifunedev/orchestra-api:4.0.0` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Docs part accepted at b26a33bf: docs/releasing.md states bump (3 files), parity check, changelog move, PR merge, fast-forward main, monitoring, no-op meaning, images/tags, verification; ste-check exit 0. docs/README.md links releasing.md (and roadmap.md). Live criteria pending post-merge with operator consent: create main, first release v4.0.0, gh release view, docker manifest inspect, delete origin/master.
